The Flyers, led by first year head coach [[Archie Miller (basketball)|Archie Miller]], played their home games at the [[University of Dayton Arena]] and are members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 20–13 and 9–7 in A-10 to finish in a four way tie for fifth place. They were champions of the 2011 [[Old Spice Classic]]. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2012 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 Basketball tournament]] to Xavier.
